title: Map plan
description: What a Mapper job acquires. Lengths in metres, times in seconds. Give the area as box_m in stage coordinates, or as size_m around centre_m (default: the current stage position); tile centres never leave the box. A plan with revisit points or a revisit map and no area only images those (no tiles); its area is the points' (or the map's) extent.

dry_run.description: Rehearse the plan without moving anything: reads pass through, stage moves and acquisitions are recorded in the trace (dry_run: true) and checked against the box, nothing is acquired, the beam is still blanked. Taken by every job device; approved like a real start.

box_m.description: [x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max] in stage metres.

size_m.description: [width, height] in metres; the Mapper centres the box on centre_m.

centre_m.description: [x, y] stage centre for size_m; defaults to the current stage position.

per_tile.description: Extra actions at every tile. eds_point is one spectrum at the tile centre; eds_map is a coarse spectrum image and must be asked for by name.

dose_budget_e_per_a2.description: Refuse the plan if any point would receive more than this (electron-beam profiles: stem, sem). The same as budgets.dose_e_per_a2.

budgets.description: Refuse the plan at reserve, before anything moves, if it would spend more than any of these. Every instrument has time_s (the estimated duration); the profile adds its own: dose_e_per_a2 for an electron beam, and a YAML instrument's map budgets (an AFM's tip_force_nn).

settings.description: Instrument settings for the whole map (yaml profile: the settings the instrument file's map section lists, e.g. an AFM's setpoint_v).

z_m.description: Stage z for every tile; defaults to the current z.

stitch.description: Stitch the finished run into a zoomable map on the analysis server (needs a Mapper with analysis_url); EDS point spectra become points of interest.

find_regions.description: After stitching, score the map and add the best N regions as points of interest.

drift.description: Live drift tracking (off by default): before each tile a bounded image shift cancels the drift measured so far by registering overlapping tiles; the stage still goes only to the planned tile centres. Refused at reserve on an instrument profile that cannot shift the image. Every correction is in the Instrument Trace (Mapper.drift_correction).

max_shift_m.description: Largest change of the image shift, per axis, one correction may make (default a tenth of the tile's fov_m).

max_total_m.description: Largest image shift, per axis, from its value before the map (default and maximum: the instrument profile's image shift limit).

tracker.description: The drift tracker (asyncroscopy.routines.drift): linear (a line fitted on the instrument's clock), or one registered by a plug-in.

window.description: Most recent measurements the linear tracker fits.

fov_m.description: Field of view of the higher-magnification image taken at each region: from a twentieth of the tile's fov_m up to fov_m.

imsize.description: Pixels per side of each revisit image (default: the tiles').

dwell_s.description: Dwell time per pixel of each revisit image (default: the tiles'); its dose counts against dose_budget_e_per_a2.

points.description: Stage [x, y] (metres) to image, instead of regions found by find_regions.

map.description: An existing stitched map whose best scored regions (top_k) are imaged, instead of mapping again.

top_k.description: How many of the map's best scored regions to image (with map; default 3).

revisit.description: Image each region find_regions found at higher magnification (inside the plan box only); the images are linked to their points of interest.
